The '''Eriadu orbital shipyards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipbuilding facilities]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Compared to other shipyards in the galaxy, the Eriadu shipyards were just smaller than the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]].<ref name="DMS" />

At the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Eriadu orbital shipyards were operated by [[Valorum Shipping and Transport]], a company owned by distant cousins of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="DMS" />
